senses.gloss: m. (וָתַר) the retailer’s customary addition to exact measure.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 32b:12">Ned. 32ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 57b:5">B. Bath. 57ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אפילו ו׳ אסור וכ׳</he> if one forswears himself any benefit from his neighbor, he dare not even accept the customary addition &c.
